## Cards · color=#b3541e

### 1890 · Hollerith tabulator
Punched cards sorted by machine for the US census.

## Stored programs

### 1945 · Merge sort
John von Neumann merges sorted runs.

### 1961 · Quicksort
Tony Hoare partitions around a pivot.

## Libraries

### 2002 · Timsort
Tim Peters writes the sort Python still uses.
